infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DSH Remote uses the camera to take photos you attach to a conversation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DSH Remote lets you pick photos to attach to a conversation or upload to a workspace.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DSH Remote can save images from your workspace to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DSH Remote does not record audio; this is required by the WebRTC transport library.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DSH Remote connects directly to your DeepSeek Harness host on the local network when possible.
